correctness.rationale: Conditioning gives an exact common-factor integral. Uniform large-argument incomplete-gamma expansions on t^(1/4)<=x<=t^(3/4), exponentially negligible complements, and a classical K-Bessel integral establish the exact ray constant and exponent for all fixed positive shapes. Uniform relative comparison yields an O(t^(-1/4)) total-variation GIG approximation. A nondegenerate strict saddle yields conditional N(0,1/2) fluctuations; a quantile sandwich yields the √m logarithmic copula exponent. Standalone exact finite-sum Bessel calculation matches independent quadrature; numerical checks do not substitute for limits.

value.rationale: Simultaneous upper-tail exceedances of a dependent gamma-gamma vector are natural in reliability and fading risk. The exact prefactor is needed to calibrate rare joint exceedances where exponent-only estimates are not enough, for arbitrary positive directions and heterogeneous shapes. Conditional GIG/normal localization explains the latent rare-event mechanism and motivates targeted rare-event simulation, without any need for a downstream theorem or growing-dimensional result.
